Accepted: the intake test asserts the `@<endpoint|@none>` rendering, exactly one message line per refused seat (a two-seat fixture), and pins both claim adapters' call counts at base (1) vs head (0) on the same roster.
Accepted: a standing-pin fixture (the qc seat admitted only through the pin store the intake consults) is added next to the override case; both still refuse.
Accepted: same fold as 87863d4e — sealed contract + real appender + real sandbox ledger stated explicitly for the routing run.
Accepted: the resolver fixture carries TWO incompatible seats (codex at [0], cursor at [2]) and asserts two distinct entries in order; a single-warning implementation fails.
